WITH order_discounts_agg AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total_discounts
    FROM order_discounts
    GROUP BY order_id
),
order_shipments_agg AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(shipping_fee) AS total_shipping
    FROM order_shipments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name,
    SUM(o.base_amount)                       AS total_gross_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(od.total_discounts, 0.00))  AS total_discount_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(os.total_shipping,  0.00))  AS total_shipping_fees
FROM merchants m
JOIN orders o
    ON o.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN order_discounts_agg od
    ON od.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN order_shipments_agg os
    ON os.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name;

tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_timestamp
    FROM user_events
),
session_flags AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN prev_timestamp IS NULL
                  OR event_timestamp - prev_timestamp > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*)             AS event_count
FROM session_flags
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;

        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_time END) AS first_cart,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase'    THEN event_time END) AS first_purchase
    FROM user_journey_events

),
funnel AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        first_view                                                             AS view_time,
